question.text: If the tangent to the ellipse <math><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>16</mn></math> at <math><mi>P</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>4</mn><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">cos</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">θ</mi></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">sin</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">θ</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow></mfenced></math> is also a normal to the circle <math><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>,</mo></math> then the sum of all possible values of <math><mi mathvariant="normal">θ</mi></math> is equal to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>θ</mi><mo>∈</mo><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi></mrow></mfenced></mrow></mfenced></math>

solution.text:
Tangent to the ellipse is xcos⁡θ+2ysin⁡θ=4 which is a normal to the given circle
⇒ it satisfies 4,2
⇒sin⁡θ+cos⁡θ=1
∴θ=0,π2
